perspective: We act for the service provider. Lower caps, shorter tails and faster payment favour our client.

decisions.OK: Clause meets our standard position. No change.
decisions.negotiate: Clause is worse than our position but short of the walk-away. Propose the fallback clause from clause_library.json.
decisions.escalate: Clause hits a walk-away condition, or cannot be read with confidence. A partner decides.

confidentiality_term.title: Confidentiality term
confidentiality_term.position: Confidentiality obligations last no more than 3 years after disclosure.
confidentiality_term.fallback: 3 years, with trade secrets protected for as long as they remain trade secrets.
confidentiality_term.walk_away: Perpetual obligations for all information, or a term longer than 7 years.

limitation_of_liability.title: Limitation of liability
limitation_of_liability.position: Total liability capped at the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.
limitation_of_liability.fallback: Cap at fees paid in the prior 24 months, with carve-outs only for confidentiality breach and indemnity.
limitation_of_liability.walk_away: Uncapped or unlimited liability for our client.

indemnification.title: Indemnification
indemnification.position: Mutual indemnities, each limited to third-party claims.
indemnification.fallback: Mutual indemnities for third-party IP and confidentiality claims, subject to the liability cap.
indemnification.walk_away: One-sided indemnity from our client that is not subject to any cap.

governing_law.title: Governing law
governing_law.fallback: Any US state law, with venue in that state's courts.

payment_terms.title: Payment terms
payment_terms.fallback: Invoices due within 45 days, with late interest of 1% per month.

auto_renewal.title: Auto-renewal
auto_renewal.position: No auto-renewal, or non-renewal notice of 30 days or less.
auto_renewal.fallback: Auto-renewal for one-year terms with 60 days' non-renewal notice.

non_solicitation.title: Non-solicitation of employees
non_solicitation.fallback: Mutual, 12 months, excluding general job advertisements.

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.position: Neither party may assign without consent, not to be unreasonably withheld.
assignment.fallback: Consent not unreasonably withheld, with a carve-out for a merger or sale of the business.
assignment.walk_away: The counterparty may assign freely while our client may not.
